        <id>blocklist.enabled</id>

    <field>
        <id>blocklist.lists</id>
        <label>URLs of Blocklists</label>
        <type>select_multiple</type>
        <style>tokenize</style>
        <allownew>true</allownew>

        <help>List of domains from where blocklist will be downloaded.</help>
    </field>
    <field>

        <type>select_multiple</type>
        <style>tokenize</style>

        <help>List of domains to allow. You can use regular expressions. This allow list only applies to blocklist matches on items in this policy.</help>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>blocklist.blocklists</id>
        <label>Blocklist Domains</label>
        <type>select_multiple</type>
        <style>tokenize</style>
        <allownew>true</allownew>
        <help>List of domains to blocklist. Only exact matches are supported.</help>
    </field>
    <field>

        </help>

        <grid_view>
            <visible>false</visible>
        </grid_view>

        <id>blocklist.nxdomain</id>

        <type>checkbox</type>
        <advanced>true</advanced>
        <help>Use the DNS response code NXDOMAIN instead of a destination address.</help>
        <grid_view>
            <type>boolean</type>
            <formatter>boolean</formatter>
            <visible>false</visible>
        </grid_view>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>blocklist.description</id>
        <label>Description</label>
        <type>text</type>
    </field>
</form>

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, uuid, shutil

root = tree.getroot()
unboundplus = root.find('OPNsense/unboundplus')

entry = ET.SubElement(dnsbl, 'blocklist')

ET.SubElement(entry, 'type').text = ''
